review.notes: Candidate 0 of 16: a shack of light grey tin sheets and grey-tan planks, a hazard yellow cogwheel on its front, a sand-buff hide awning and a workbench under it; the live Goblin tin, sand and yellow. The plate hint is a false alarm: nothing is drawn under it. The sheet varies widely: 1, 3, 4 and 12 are rust-brown scrap (the retired Scrap look); 2, 5 to 11, 13 and 14 are plain brown wooden sheds, most with no yellow cog; 15 has windmill sails.

chibi-goblin-forge.subject: IMPROVEMENT:GOBLIN:FORGE
chibi-goblin-forge.notes: Candidate 0 of 16: a hut of patched light grey tin with a hazard yellow panel, a bent tin chimney pipe with a small smoke puff, an oil-drum furnace with an orange fire in its open front and a dented anvil on a tree stump; the clearest yellow panel and smoke of the sheet. The sixteen are one plan: 11 and 13 have no pipe; 3, 6, 7, 9 and 14 a leaning sheet over the yellow; 1, 2, 4, 5, 8, 10, 12 and 15 a smaller or paler panel.

chibi-goblin-lumber-camp.subject: IMPROVEMENT:GOBLIN:LUMBER_CAMP
chibi-goblin-lumber-camp.notes: Candidate 4 of 16: a crooked half-dead scrub tree with a few olive-yellow leaves, three sawn stumps with a cleaver axe in the front one, and a patched sand-buff lean-to with a tin sheet and a hazard yellow patch: scrap and stumps, the Goblin scrub cut down. 8 and 14 are the same plan with a paler patch; 12 adds a log but has no yellow; 0 has no lean-to; 1 no third stump; 2, 3, 5 to 7, 9 to 11, 13 and 15 have neat log stacks and no axe, which read as the Human camp.

chibi-goblin-market.subject: IMPROVEMENT:GOBLIN:MARKET
chibi-goblin-market.notes: Candidate 0 of 16: two rickety open stalls of grey-tan planks under patched sand-buff hide awnings with one hazard yellow patch, the counters holding a loose cog and dented tin pots, an old barrel and a lumpy sack in front; no pixel of the owner key red. 11 is close but crowded; 12 spills loose pebbles; 13 has a mushroom crate and no barrel; 14 has tent-shaped roofs; 5 a whole yellow awning; the rest show bare counters. The plate hint on 6, 7, 13 and 14 is their dark shade under the counters, not a plate.

chibi-goblin-port.subject: IMPROVEMENT:GOBLIN:PORT
chibi-goblin-port.notes: Candidate 12 of 16: a wide rickety pier of grey-tan planks on uneven posts, a small patched tin hut with a hazard yellow door in the middle of it, crooked mooring posts, a coil of rope and a barrel; the widest whole deck of the sheet. The sixteen are one plan: 13 and 14 are close; 0, 3 to 5 and 9 have a door turned away or no yellow; 1, 2, 6, 8 and 15 an L-shaped deck; 7, 10 and 11 steps down to the water.

chibi-goblin-sawmill.subject: IMPROVEMENT:GOBLIN:SAWMILL
chibi-goblin-sawmill.notes: Candidate 7 of 16: a ramshackle hut of patched light grey tin sheets and grey-tan planks with a hazard yellow door and a bent chimney pipe, a toothed tin saw blade standing in a rickety bench, a heap of crooked planks and a sawn stump; its blade has the clearest teeth of the sheet. The sixteen are one plan; in the others the blade is a plain grey disc (1, 9, 10, 12 to 15) or lies low in the bench (0, 2 to 6, 8, 11).
